### Learning Objectives

- Operations that preserve convexity
  - Intersection
  - Cartesian Product
  - Affine Transformation
  - Perspective and Linear Fractional Transformation
- Introduce Disciplined Convex Programming

### Readings


- Sections 2.3 of [Convex Optimization](https://web.stanford.edu/~boyd/cvxbook/bv_cvxbook.pdf)
- Start looking at `cvx` user guides:
  - [cvxpy](https://www.cvxpy.org/tutorial/dcp/)
  - [cvxr](https://cvxr.rbind.io/)
